highlights: The app is called Nisabitus everywhere now. Backups taken before the change still open.
On a wide window the content no longer stretches edge to edge: it stays at a width that is comfortable to read.
Medication: adherence is measured against what was active on each day, so starting something new no longer counts as days missed.
The panel now carries shortcuts to the other modules.
Streaks: record a day you forgot, up to a year back, and rescue the run.
Habits and streaks: track what you repeat and see how long you have kept it up.
Health: sleep, food, training and medication, all on the same day.
Journal, Pomodoro and a to-do board with nested projects.
Every module has its own progress view, over a day, a week, a month or a year.
Backups: export everything to a file and load it back whenever you want.
It all lives on your device. No account, no server, no connection.
